## 2. Job Description

Lumenfield Logistics runs temperature-controlled freight between Berlin, Leipzig and Rotterdam. We are looking for an
Operations Analyst to join the network planning team in Berlin.

What you will do:
- Build and maintain weekly reports on depot throughput, dock utilisation and on-time delivery.
- Analyse delays with the planners and propose changes to routes and slot allocation.
- Reconcile carrier invoices with shipment data and flag billing errors.
- Present the numbers to the network operations manager every month.

What you bring:
- 3+ years in an analyst role in logistics, supply chain or operations.
- Strong Excel and SQL; experience with Power BI or a similar tool.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.

We offer a hybrid setup with two office days a week, 30 days of leave and a public transport pass.
